Australia Names 16-Player Squad for South Africa Test Series

Cricket Australia has announced a 16-man squad for the upcoming Test series against South Africa. The squad includes a pace-heavy selection, with Marnus Labuschagne retained. The series is considered key for the World Test Championship.
